en-US: First Google Play release. Wireless QR/code pairing, USB ADB, remote screen control, six-row keyboard, remote audio and optional microphone forwarding. Updated for Android 16 with system Back forwarding and safe-area layout support.
zh-CN: 首个 Google Play 版本。支持二维码/配对码无线配对、USB ADB、远控画面、六行键盘、远端声音与按需麦克风转发。适配 Android 16 的系统返回操作和安全区布局。
